outcome: Pattern of cutaneous manifestations in newborns
finding: Transient and physiological skin changes were the most frequent cutaneous manifestations observed in newborns within 72 hours of birth, with a higher number of lesions observed in premature babies.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of delivery for 34.5% of the newborns.
